description:
Maps and geographic data: coordinate systems (WGS84 and others), raster and elevation
        layers, spatial indexing, vector features and topology, editable zones and 3D terrain. With
        a workflow name, the exact nodes, pins, links and settings of that workflow. Results follow
        this server's native catalog; workflows whose nodes are missing are not offered as runnable.
        Does not execute the graph.
        Example: get_geospatial_capabilities(workflow="vector_gis").

include_unavailable.description: Also list workflows whose nodes are missing from this server's catalog.
include_unavailable.title: Include Unavailable

workflow.description: A workflow name (e.g. coastal_raster, tiled_raster, indexed_features, vector_gis) for its pins, links and settings. Empty returns the overview.
workflow.title: Workflow

name: get_geospatial_capabilities
title: Discover geographic and map workflows
